about: Work queue for the local agent (see HANDOFF.md). Written by the cloud orchestrator at the end of every iteration. The local agent never edits this file; it records progress in docs/local-done.json. A blocked task is retried when its rev is bumped, when a task in its depends_on finishes after the block, or after retry_after_hours (default 12). Tasks with per_machine true are done once on every machine. Several machines may run the local agent; docs/local-lease.json makes sure only one works at a time.

cloud.summary: Iteration 1 is planning the first full version of the site (the architecture and station list are drafted). No stations, videos or narration exist yet, so the only local work is L2-audio-api.

tasks.title: Check the local toolchain
tasks.why: Every later task needs node, git push access, ffmpeg and manim, plus Doppler for audio. Done once on every machine that runs the local agent (the Mac and the Linux box).
steps: Run `node tools/local/check.mjs --tools` and read the tool report.

If anything is missing, do not try to install it from an unattended run (Homebrew needs the student). Record the task as blocked with needs_from_student: "Run `bash tools/local/setup.sh` and accept the install for <missing tools>."
Confirm pushing works: `git push --dry-run origin <branch>`. Record the done entry with your machine name (AGENT_NAME from .local/dispatch.env).
done_when: `node tools/local/check.mjs --tools` reports node, git, npm, ffmpeg, doppler, claude and manim as ok

tasks.title: Make the OpenRouter audio calls work (ElevenLabs speech, Lyria music)
tasks.why: tools/media/generate-audio.mjs was written in the cloud without access to openrouter.ai, so its audio requests are untested. Rev 2: the rev-1 block came from a tick that ran in a sandboxed VM; L1-setup is now done on the Mac (Doppler config dev, provisioning key OPENROUTER_ADMIN, which the script already detects).
steps: List secret names (never values): `bash tools/local/run.sh secret-names`. If the provisioning (admin) key has a name the script does not look for, set "keyVar" in media/audio-config.json.
List audio-capable models: `bash tools/local/run.sh audio --list-models`. Pick the ElevenLabs speech model and the Google Lyria music model.

Read OpenRouter's current documentation (WebFetch on openrouter.ai/docs) for requesting audio output from those models, and fix openrouterAudio() in tools/media/generate-audio.mjs so the documented request shape is tried first.

Test in a scratch folder so nothing in media/ changes: create .local/audio-test/site/test.json with one short speech segment and a music prompt of 20 seconds, then `bash tools/local/run.sh audio --narration-dir .local/audio-test --audio-dir .local/audio-test/out --tts-model <id> --music-model <id>`. Check both files with ffprobe (non-zero duration, audio stream present).

Save the choices in media/audio-config.json: voice (warm, clear, unhurried; suited to explaining maths the night before a test), ttsModel, musicModel, limitUsd 5. Commit tools/media and media/audio-config.json.
done_when: one speech clip and one music clip were generated through OpenRouter and are valid audio
media/audio-config.json records the voice and both models
the temporary OpenRouter key was deleted (the script prints 'Deleted the temporary OpenRouter key.')

tasks.title: Turn on GitHub Pages for the gh-pages branch (one time)
tasks.why: The Pages workflow already builds the site and pushes it to the gh-pages branch, but GitHub only switches Pages on by itself for pushes made by a person, and the cloud's GitHub connector cannot change repository settings. With Pages on, the student can open https://codexoperator.github.io/math-viz/ on their phone.
steps: Check: `gh api repos/CodexOperator/math-viz/pages`. If it returns JSON with source.branch = gh-pages, Pages is already on; go to the last step.
If it returns 404: `gh api -X POST repos/CodexOperator/math-viz/pages -f 'source[branch]=gh-pages' -f 'source[path]=/'`.

If `gh` is missing, not logged in (`gh auth status`), or the command is not allowed in this run, record the task as blocked with needs_from_student: "Turn on Pages once: on github.com open CodexOperator/math-viz > Settings > Pages, set Source to 'Deploy from a branch', Branch 'gh-pages' and folder '/ (root)', then Save. Or run: gh api -X POST repos/CodexOperator/math-viz/pages -f 'source[branch]=gh-pages' -f 'source[path]=/'"
Wait a minute, then `curl -sI https://codexoperator.github.io/math-viz/` and expect HTTP 200.
